```{=html}
<div style="width:100%;height:720px;box-sizing:border-box;padding:22px 48px 18px 48px;background:#ffffff;color:#1f2937;font-family:Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;display:flex;flex-direction:column;text-align:left;">
  <div style="border-bottom:1px solid #d7dee8;padding-bottom:6px;margin-bottom:8px;">
    <h1 style="font-size:28px;line-height:1.12;font-weight:720;color:#1f2a44;letter-spacing:-0.1px;margin:0;padding:0;white-space:nowrap;">Feature Engineering &amp; Selection</h1>
  </div>

  <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:1;">

    <div style="width:90%;padding:12px 24px 12px 24px;background:#fbfdff;border:1px solid #d6e4fb;border-left:3px solid #315f9f;border-radius:12px;box-sizing:border-box;box-shadow:0 4px 10px rgba(49,95,159,0.10);">
      <div style="font-size:20px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;margin-bottom:6px;">Feature Selection — 22 features from 170+ columns</div>
      <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:3px 28px;font-size:16px;line-height:1.32;color:#344054;">
        <div><strong style="color:#1f2a44;">Demographics:</strong> Age, EdLevel, WorkExp, YearsCode</div>
        <div><strong style="color:#1f2a44;">AI Attitudes:</strong> AISelect, AISent, AIAcc, AIThreat</div>
        <div><strong style="color:#1f2a44;">Employment:</strong> Employment, RemoteWork, OrgSize, ICorPM</div>
        <div><strong style="color:#1f2a44;">Compensation:</strong> ConvertedCompYearly</div>
        <div><strong style="color:#1f2a44;">Geography:</strong> Country, Industry, DevType</div>
        <div><strong style="color:#1f2a44;">Tools:</strong> ToolCountWork, ToolCountPersonal</div>
        <div><strong style="color:#1f2a44;">Career Intent:</strong> NewRole, PurchaseInfluence</div>
        <div><strong style="color:#1f2a44;">Derived:</strong> LeavingScore (ordinal 0–4)</div>
        <div><strong style="color:#1f2a44;">Work Context:</strong> TechEndorseIntro</div>
        <div></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div style="font-size:20px;line-height:1;color:#315f9f;font-weight:800;">↓</div>

    <div style="width:90%;padding:12px 24px;background:#fbfdff;border:1px solid #d6e4fb;border-left:3px solid #315f9f;border-radius:12px;box-sizing:border-box;box-shadow:0 4px 10px rgba(49,95,159,0.10);">
      <div style="font-size:20px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;margin-bottom:6px;">Feature Engineering — training-set parameters only</div>
      <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:4px 20px;font-size:16px;line-height:1.32;color:#344054;">
        <div><strong style="color:#1f2a44;">Numeric:</strong> median imputation, 99th percentile capping, salary log-transform</div>
        <div><strong style="color:#1f2a44;">Categorical:</strong> rare → "Other" (top-15), missing → "Missing"</div>
        <div><strong style="color:#1f2a44;">Multi-response:</strong> semicolon-split → binary columns; top-15 retained</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div style="font-size:20px;line-height:1;color:#315f9f;font-weight:800;">↓</div>

    <div style="width:90%;padding:12px 24px;background:#fbfdff;border:1px solid #d6e4fb;border-left:3px solid #315f9f;border-radius:12px;box-sizing:border-box;box-shadow:0 4px 10px rgba(49,95,159,0.10);">
      <div style="font-size:20px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;margin-bottom:6px;">Feature Filtering — 3 automated filters</div>
      <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:4px 20px;font-size:16px;line-height:1.32;color:#344054;">
        <div><strong style="color:#1f2a44;">Near-zero variance:</strong> remove if &gt;95% identical</div>
        <div><strong style="color:#1f2a44;">High correlation:</strong> drop one if r &gt; 0.90</div>
        <div><strong style="color:#1f2a44;">High missing rate:</strong> remove if &gt;80% missing</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div style="font-size:20px;line-height:1;color:#315f9f;font-weight:800;">↓</div>

    <div style="width:70%;text-align:center;padding:11px 20px;background:#f4f8ff;border:1px solid #c8dcfa;border-radius:12px;box-sizing:border-box;box-shadow:0 4px 10px rgba(49,95,159,0.10);">
      <p style="font-size:18px;line-height:1.22;font-weight:750;color:#1f2a44;margin:0;padding:0;">170+ raw → 22 selected → ~120 encoded → filtered → shared feature set for all 5 models</p>
    </div>

  </div>
</div>
```
